messages:
alex_k: Hey @maria-peopleops — quick Q: my partner (covered as my dependent) is moving from full‑time student to part‑time effective 2026-06-01. Do they lose dependent eligibility right away? What proof do you need and how does payroll proration work if coverage ends mid‑month? Any COBRA/temporary options? Thanks!

maria-peopleops: Hi Alex — short answer: it depends on age + how they were covered. If they’re on the plan solely because they were a full‑time student and they’re over the age cutoff, loss of FT status triggers dependent termination. We usually allow coverage through the end of the academic term or the last day of the month of the loss, whichever applies per carrier.

alex_k: They’re 23 and were listed as a student-dependent. Their semester ends 2026-05-15 and they switch to part-time 6/1. Should I submit the registrar letter now?

maria-peopleops: Yes please submit the registrar letter showing enrollment status and effective dates. Send it to benefits@redwood.com or upload in the benefits portal. When we receive the doc we’ll set the dependent end date. Typical timeline: doc received -> we update coverage -> payroll adjusts premiums on next cycle.

maria-peopleops: Required docs (copy/paste):
```
- Official registrar letter or final transcript showing full-time status and dates
- Dependent government ID (passport/driver's license)
- If semester end differs from registrar wording, a school-provided note with effective date
```

payroll: FYI on premiums — premiums are collected based on the payroll period. If coverage ends mid-month we prorate the employee portion on the next paycheck after the termination date is processed. If termination aligns to end of month, full month premium applies. If you need an exact dollar estimate, reply with your pay schedule and I’ll run numbers.

benefits-bot: :gear: Ticket created: B-12345 — "Dependent student status change for alex_k". Please attach registrar doc to that ticket or reply here with confirmation once uploaded.

erica-hr: Quick note on continuation: If the dependent loses eligibility due to loss of student status, they may qualify for COBRA continuation. COBRA packet is sent by our vendor within ~14 days of the qualifying event; they get 60 days to elect. If you want to add a short-term paid plan while you sort this, let us know and we can check vendor options.

alex_k: Great — uploaded registrar PDF to the portal and added a copy to ticket B-12345. Subject line: "Dependent student status change — Alex K". Thanks all.

maria-peopleops: Got it, checking now. If everything looks good we’ll set termination to 2026-05-31 (end of month) unless school doc requires 5/15; I’ll confirm in the ticket by EOD. :thumbsup:

jane-p: thanks for making the upload easy — appreciate the quick turnaround team :pray:

benefits-bot: Update: Ticket B-12345 moved to "In review" by maria-peopleops at 1777777805.

maria-peopleops: Confirmed — we will terminate dependent coverage effective 2026-05-31 per registrar. Payroll: please prorate premiums accordingly. ERICA: please trigger COBRA notice once termination is processed.

payroll: Noted — will prorate on next run and post payroll adjustment.

erica-hr: Will send COBRA packet to dependent email on file within 14 days.

alex_k: Awesome, thanks everyone. Appreciate the fast help! :raised_hands:
